description:
Make a five-slide sales deck for one account, with a PDF, in a catalog design system or the team's own brand. Pass the account's company, website, offer and call-to-action link. Better Design writes every slide and draws the visual. The first slide shows your logo beside the account's when you pass `sellerWebsite`.

Before it is ready, the deck is checked for text that runs off a slide, a font that did not load and a wrong size, and spilled text is rewritten shorter once. Call get-asset with the returned id to read the result.

Each call spends 5 Better Design credits and returns public links at once: `viewUrl` shows progress, then the deck; `pdfUrl` is the PDF once it is ready. Take `designSystemId` from find-design-system, or pass the `projectId` create-design-system returned to use the team's own brand. It needs a Better Design account with a verified email.

ctaLabel.description: Optional. The button label on the last slide, for example "Book a call".

ctaUrl.description: Where the call to action goes, for example your calendar link.

designSystemId.description: A catalog design system id from find-design-system, for example "cashmere". It sets the colours and type. Pass this or projectId.

notes.description: Optional. What you know about the account: its business, its problem, the conversation so far.

offer.description: What you offer this account and what it gets.

projectId.description: The projectId create-design-system returned for the team's own brand. The asset uses that brand's colours and type. Pass this or designSystemId.

sellerName.description: Optional. Your company's name, shown beside the account's on the first slide.

sellerWebsite.description: Optional. Your company's website. The first slide shows its logo beside the account's.

website.description: The account's website, for example https://acme.com.

name: make-slides
title: Make a Slide Deck
